jobs.description_text: About Parkade Parkade is a B2B2C SaaS platform that modernizes private parking for apartments, mixed-use, and offices. We help buildings move away from the headaches of stickers, hang tags, and spreadsheets to a fully automated, self-serve app for parking management, enforcement, and customer service. We have carved out a highly differentiated position in a massive PropTech market, our customers love us, and we closed a successful Series A funding round. Parkade is officially in hypergrowth. We're a lean, high-impact team where your work is visible, your ideas matter, and there's real room to shape how things get done. The Role We are seeking a skilled and motivated engineer with a strong interest in and background in front-end web development. Reporting directly to the VP of Engineering, you will be a critical player who makes a meaningful impact and the technical decisions you make matter. We’re looking for someone who will - Care deeply about the product and user experience. - Be forward thinking in terms of pragmatic and responsible AI adoption for your own dev work and for the team. - Make sound architectural and design decisions informed by your past achievements and mistakes. - Produce prolifically with AI assistance and the mature judgment of a staff engineer. - Enjoy a fast moving, dynamic startup environment. - Be curious, continuously and proactively level up your skills. - Rely on at least 5 years of hands-on front-end experience building commercial applications. Our tech stack - TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Vite, TanStack Router - Tailwind CSS, Material UI - TanStack Query, React Hook Form, Pineapple Express - Vitest, Playwright - Stripe, Firebase, Sentry Bonus Points - You have built something significant from the ground up before. - You are proficient with Python or a similar backend language. - You have experience setting up and improving CI/CD infrastructure. - You care about problems related to parking and efficient use of space and resources in cities. Benefits - Health, vision, and dental insurance (80% covered for you and dependents) - 401k - Flexible PTO - Equity in Parkade Please note: We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role at this time. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship, now or in the future.
jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Front End
